lines.text: Divina, my whole feed is going mad about skills. What even is that?
A skill is a little instruction pack that teaches an AI agent to do one job properly. Review code, design a page, write tests.
So a cheat sheet for robots?
For once, yes. And Vercel's skills tool is blowing up on GitHub. One command puts them into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and seventy five more.
Aye, but that's a command again.
Which is why people like you have Obstat. Paste the repo in, then press Build a UI.
If an app is only a command line tool, Obstat turns its options into a proper screen. Boxes, buttons, no terminal.
And if I want it fancy?
Ask Claude Code, Codex or Gemini to build you a custom one. Obstat hands them the job.
I know. Obstat. Free for Windows.
